text: くやしいが　やられた！

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part means 'but'. くやしいが = 'it's frustrating, but'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending turns 'do' into 'have it done to you'. やる is 'to do someone in', so やられた = 'I got beaten'.
